Thought: Based on the clues in the task, it appears that on July 15, 2008 Phys.org published an article discussing a well-known catastrophe. Cross‐references (for example, from Encyclopedia Britannica) indicate that the explosive force of this catastrophe has been estimated to be roughly equivalent to about 15 megatons of TNT; many sources have long compared that yield with that of the US nuclear test Castle Bravo. Since Castle Bravo’s yield was around 15 megatons, the US test with the matching yield is Castle Bravo – and the answer requires the last word of that test’s name. Therefore, the final answer is "Bravo".
